description: Crew/agent memory right-sizing for gardenio's own crew pods (container="agent", pod=~"crew-.*", namespace="gardenio-system"). Actual working set vs configured request, over-provision factor, and OOM guardrails. All series are scraped into gardenio VictoriaMetrics (datasource uid `victoriametrics`) by the in-chart vmagent (cadvisor kubelet /metrics/resource) and kube-state-metrics. The VPA *recommended* line is not yet available — no VPA CRD/recommender is deployed on prod-gardenio-eks (epic ka-0000005189); those panels are collected in the collapsed ‘Pending’ row. See docs/vpa-guardrails.md.

options.content:
> ### Crew memory right-sizing — gardenio-system crew pods
> Actual working set, configured request, and OOM guardrails for gardenio's own crew/agent pods (`namespace="gardenio-system"`, `pod=~"crew-.*"`, `container="agent"`). All series are scraped into **gardenio VictoriaMetrics** (datasource uid `victoriametrics`): `container_memory_working_set_bytes` via the vmagent kubelet `/metrics/resource` scrape, and `kube_pod_container_resource_requests/limits` + OOM/restart series via kube-state-metrics.
>
> **The VPA _recommended_ line is not deployed.** There is no VPA CRD, recommender Deployment, or reco-value exporter on prod-gardenio-eks (epic ka-0000005189), so `kube_customresource_vpa_status_recommendation_target` and the recommender `up` series do not exist. Those four panels are collected in the collapsed **‘Pending — VPA recommender not deployed’** row at the bottom rather than shown as broken tiles.

panels.title: Crew memory requested (total)
panels.description: Sum of memory REQUESTS across crew/agent containers in $namespace (gardenio-system). This is the number Karpenter scales node count off — the flat 8Gi request is the over-provisioning driver this epic targets. Sourced from kube-state-metrics, scraped into gardenio VictoriaMetrics.

panels.title: Crew memory actual (total working set)
panels.description: Sum of live working-set memory across crew/agent containers in $namespace (gardenio-system). The gap between this and 'requested' is the reclaimable headroom right-sizing recovers. Sourced from cadvisor (kubelet /metrics/resource) via the in-chart vmagent, scraped into gardenio VictoriaMetrics.

panels.title: Over-provision factor (request / actual)
panels.description: Total crew memory request divided by total live working set. Lower is tighter; the epic targets a generous-but-demand-based ratio. Green/orange/red thresholds apply against the live request and cadvisor working-set series in gardenio VictoriaMetrics.

panels.title: Actual vs request — fleet total
panels.description: The headline comparison over time. request (what Karpenter scales node count off) should stay >= actual (live working set) at all times; the gap is the reclaimable headroom right-sizing would recover. Sourced from kube-state-metrics + cadvisor in gardenio VictoriaMetrics.

panels.title: Per-crew-pod actual working set
panels.description: Live working-set memory per crew/agent pod in $namespace (gardenio-system). The spread shows how demand varies across concurrently-running agents. cadvisor series carry no gardenio.io/project label (kube_pod_labels collector disabled), so this breaks out by POD, not project. Sourced from cadvisor via the in-chart vmagent.

panels.title: Crew OOMKills — 1h
panels.description: New crew/agent container OOMKills in the last hour (the HARD GATE: this must NOT rise under right-sizing). Backs the CrewOOMKilled alert; any non-zero value after an enforce flip is a rollback signal. The `or vector(0)` fallback is gated on scrape liveness, so a green 0 appears only when the KSM restart-reason series is genuinely reporting.

targets.expr: sum(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"$namespace",pod=~"crew-.*"}[1h]) * on (namespace, pod, container) group_left max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace=~"$namespace",pod=~"crew-.*",reason="OOMKilled"})) or (vector(0) and (count(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total) > 0))

panels.title: Crew pods near memory limit
panels.description: Count of crew/agent containers whose working set exceeds 90% of their memory limit — the OOM precursor band backing the CrewMemoryNearLimit alert. The `or vector(0)` fallback is gated on scrape liveness, so a green 0 appears only when the cadvisor series is genuinely reporting.

panels.title: Crew OOMKills over time
panels.description: Rate of new crew/agent OOMKills. Flat-zero is the healthy state; any step up is a killed agent run — watch this across an enforce flip. Sourced from kube-state-metrics restart/termination-reason series in gardenio VictoriaMetrics. The `or vector(0)` fallback is gated on scrape liveness so a live scrape with no OOMKills reads a flat-zero healthy line rather than 'No data'.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"$namespace",pod=~"crew-.*"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (namespace, pod, container) group_left max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace=~"$namespace",pod=~"crew-.*",reason="OOMKilled"})) or (vector(0) and (count(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"$namespace",pod=~"crew-.*"}) > 0))

panels.title: Pending — VPA recommender not deployed (epic ka-0000005189)
VPA recommended (total target)
panels.description: Sum of VPA recommended memory targets across gardenio VPA objects (kube_customresource_vpa_status_recommendation_target). PENDING: no VPA CRD, recommender, or reco-value exporter is deployed on prod-gardenio-eks (epic ka-0000005189), so this series does not exist yet. This is the demand-based request right-sizing would apply once the recommender ships.

defaults.noValue: pending — VPA recommender not deployed (epic ka-0000005189)

panels.title: VPA recommended target per class
panels.description: Recommended memory target per VPA object, labelled by target_name — one line per per-project×role crew workload class once VPAs exist (scoping task ka-0000001210). PENDING: no recommender/exporter deployed on prod-gardenio-eks (epic ka-0000005189), so this reads empty today.

defaults.noValue: pending — VPA recommender not deployed (epic ka-0000005189)

panels.title: VPA recommender up
panels.description: 1 when the vpa-recommender scrape target is up. Backs the VPARecommenderDown alert. PENDING: no recommender is deployed on prod-gardenio-eks (epic ka-0000005189), so no `up` series exists; an absent series reads neutral 'no data' rather than a fabricated red DOWN.

defaults.noValue: pending — VPA recommender not deployed (epic ka-0000005189)

panels.title: VPAs matched, no recommendation
panels.description: VPA objects that match live pods but carry no recommendation (recommender up but not producing). Backs VPARecommenderNoRecommendation. PENDING: no recommender deployed on prod-gardenio-eks (epic ka-0000005189), so this reads empty today.

defaults.noValue: pending — VPA recommender not deployed (epic ka-0000005189)

panels.title: Working-set percentiles — the number to set requests from
Per-pod working-set p50 / p95 / p99 over the window (vs current request)

defaults.noValue: no crew-pod memory samples in the window — either no crew pod ran, or container metrics are not being scraped

panels.description: Right-sizing reads off percentiles, not means: set the request near p95 of the observed working set and the over-provision factor above falls without buying OOMKills. Computed with quantile_over_time across the dashboard range, next to the request actually in force.
